label: TP
reason: User-controlled header input flows directly into file path construction without validation. The param variable extracted from request headers (line 61) is passed through doSomething() and concatenated into the file URI string (line 74-79) before being converted to a File object (line 80). This enables path traversal attacks where attackers can access arbitrary files within TESTFILES_DIR.

evidence.note: Data flow showing unsanized header input reaching file path
